redfin.remarks: This single-story bungalow shows true pride of ownership. Completely turnkey and exceptionally well-maintained, the home features an open kitchen flowing seamlessly into the dining room with a clean mix of tile and laminate flooring throughout. The modern kitchen is appointed with quartz countertops , an island breakfast bar , a custom backsplash , and updated cabinetry . Past the kitchen, you will find a full bathroom complete with vanity, backsplash, and tile tub/shower. The home offers two bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with an upgraded private bat, plus a separate garage space previously used as an additional bedroom. Value-adding upgrades include a solar panel system and a dedicated EV charger. Behind the house, you'll find the laundry setup and a spacious backyard perfect for outdoor entertainment and family festivities. Additional highlights include a long driveway offering tandem parking for multiple vehicles, plus rear access for additional vehicles, RV, or trailer parking.
